description: AbstractEndpoint.java is an abstract class that provides a base implementation for Eclipse Hono service endpoints, managing lifecycle, tracing, and health check registration.

classes.name: AbstractEndpoint
classes.description: An abstract class providing common functionality for Hono endpoint implementations, such as lifecycle management, tracing configuration, and health check registration.

methods.name: AbstractEndpoint
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the endpoint with a Vertx instance, ensuring it is non-null.

methods.name: setTracer
methods.description: Configures the OpenTracing tracer to be used by the endpoint, logging the tracer implementation class.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initiates startup of the endpoint, calling doStart on success or failing the future if Vertx is null.

methods.name: doStart
methods.description: Hook for subclasses to initialize resources during startup; default implementation completes immediately.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the endpoint, calling doStop on shutdown.

methods.name: doStop
methods.description: Hook for subclasses to release resources during shutdown; default implementation completes immediately.

methods.name: registerLivenessChecks
methods.description: Allows subclasses to register health checks; default does nothing.

methods.name: registerReadinessChecks
methods.description: Allows subclasses to register health checks; default does nothing.

methods.name: createEventBusMessageDeliveryOptions
methods.description: Creates DeliveryOptions for messaging that include the given SpanContext for tracing purposes.
